item.text:
The team proposes an **unapproved six-week pilot for 28 volunteer accounts**, with a budget ceiling of **USD 9,600, including support time but excluding tax**. Legal approval of data-processing terms is required before recruitment; Security sign-off is required before copying any production records. If approved, Operations will prepare the onboarding guide.

No start date has been agreed, and the proposal does not commit the company to a full rollout. Success requires **both fewer support contacts and no increase in failed transactions**. The draft does not measure customer satisfaction or long-term retention.
